api_config.description: Resource name of the API Config for this Gateway. Format: projects/{project}/locations/global/apis/{api}/configs/{apiConfig}. When changing api configs please ensure the new config is a new resource and the [lifecycle](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/meta-arguments/lifecycle) rule `create_before_destroy` is set.
api_config.rationale: The API Config specifies the configuration for the API Gateway and does not directly affect security posture.

gateway_id.description: Identifier to assign to the Gateway. Must be unique within scope of the parent resource(project).
gateway_id.rationale: The gateway identifier is used for resource identification and does not directly affect security posture.

display_name.description: A user-visible name for the API.
display_name.rationale: The display name is used for identification purposes and does not directly affect security posture.

labels.description: Resource labels to represent user-provided metadata. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Resource labels are used for metadata and do not directly affect security posture.

region.description: The region of the gateway for the API.
region.rationale: The region of the gateway is used for resource identification and does not directly affect security posture.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project ID is used for resource identification and does not directly affect security posture.
